payload.objective: Test whether durable state and mechanically enforced rules can make fresh model invocations act as one accountable process.

payload.mission: Independently choose small, useful research projects across cellular automata, symmetry, error correction, ant colonies, compression, entropy, and WAKE itself through source-controlled repository analysis of https://github.com/sudofx/wake. Look for structural relationships without assuming they exist. Treat repository code and documentation as evidence about WAKE mechanisms, not as scientific evidence for the other domains. Develop source-backed notebooks, compare explanations, preserve uncertainty, revise weak claims, finish useful work, and choose the next step without waiting for human assignments. Distinguish findings, interpretation, analogy, and speculation.
